alt: Global maps of start and end of season for summer and winter crops
title: Enhancing WorldCereal crop calendars with land surface phenology and machine learning
result: Global start- and end-of-season calendars for 11 crops from MODIS phenology, ERA5-Land climate and XGBoost, with explicit winter-cereal dormancy. R² 0.90–0.94 against reference calendars.

alt: Winter wheat NDVI time series with phenological stages and growing degree days
title: Tracking winter wheat development in thermal time
result: PlanetScope NDVI and growing degree days resolve sowing, tillering, grain filling and senescence, and the effect of fertilisation and irrigation, in a Mediterranean wheat trial.

alt: Study area in the Nile Delta with monitored fields and climate diagram
title: Field-scale crop phenology in the Nile Delta from Sen2Like and PlanetScope
result: Harmonised Landsat–Sentinel-2 data detected 91% of crop seasons across six years of wheat, maize, rice and clover fields.
citation: Cyran, Franch, …, Moletto-Lobos et al. (2025) · IJAEOG 142

alt: Location of the wheat trial in Spain and drone image of the experimental plots
title: Satellite and drone monitoring of winter wheat yield and grain quality
result: Eleven fertiliser treatments monitored with PlanetScope and UAV multispectral data. PlanetScope predicted canopy cover (R² 0.68) and yield (R² 0.54); the two platforms proved complementary.
